description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different fine-tuning methods in terms of GLUE benchmark scores, with the performance measured for both RoBERTa base and large models. The x-axis represents the fine-tuning methods, which include Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model. The y-axis indicates the GLUE performance score, ranging from approximately 84 to 88. The chart shows that the S5-model method achieves the highest performance for both RoBERTa base and large models, with the large model performing slightly better than the base model. The LoRA method also shows a high performance, particularly for the large model. The other methods, such as Prefix, Adaptor, BitFit, S1-model, and S4-model, exhibit varying levels of performance, with the base model generally outperforming the large model. The chart is color-coded, with blue bars representing the base model and orange bars representing the large model.
